issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Type Operators: As and Is; Logical Specification Type Operators Is/As
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/cql05_skeptic_probe.py: `(convert 5 to Any) as String` translated to CASE over SQL value 5 and returned 5 instead of NULL. Ad hoc confirmation also showed `(convert '5' to Any) as Integer` returned 5 and `(convert 5 to Any) is String` returned true. Per spec, as is a runtime type assertion and is tests actual runtime type; convert to Any must not erase the source primitive type and permit later assertion/conversion-like behavior.
issues.root_cause: See ARCHIVE_LOG.md CQL-05 SKEPTIC section for detailed root cause.
issues.resolution: Static convert type inference now preserves source type for `convert ... to Any` and exposes non-Any conversion targets for downstream `is`/`as`.
issues.verified_in: Fresh probe; focused pytest 28 passed; conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Type Operators: Convert and ToString/ToQuantity conversion semantics
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/cql05_skeptic_probe.py after QA-001 fix: `convert (convert '5 ''mg''' to Quantity) to String` returned the internal Quantity JSON `{'value':5.0,...}` instead of CQL Quantity string form `5.0 'mg'`. The direct spec conversion table supports Quantity -> String, and ToString(Quantity) defines the public textual representation.
issues.root_cause: See ARCHIVE_LOG.md CQL-05 SKEPTIC section for detailed root cause.
issues.resolution: `ToQuantity` and CQL `convert ... to Quantity` are recognized as Quantity-shaped, routing nested Quantity-to-String conversion through `QuantityToString`.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Type Operators: Is; Logical Specification Type Operators Is
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/cql05_skeptic_probe.py: `(null as List<Integer>) is List<Integer>` returned SQL NULL. The `Is` operator is a Boolean type test: true when the runtime type matches, false otherwise. Existing primitive/null behavior already lowers `null is Any` and `(null as Integer) is Integer` to false; composite List<T> typed null should not leak NULL through JSON resourceType probing.
issues.root_cause: See ARCHIVE_LOG.md CQL-05 SKEPTIC section for detailed root cause.
issues.resolution: Composite `as` targets now expose structural type metadata so typed-null List/Interval/Choice/Tuple `is` checks return false instead of SQL NULL.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B ToString: Quantity string representation (-)?#0.0# '<unit>'
issues.evidence: Fresh .temp/qa/cql05_skeptic_probe.py dynamic FHIR path: `convert FirstQuantity to String` over a FHIR Quantity with integer JSON value returned `5 'mg'` on forced Python fallback and `5.0 'mg'` on native-loaded registration. CQL ToString for Quantity requires decimal-format numeric text (`#0.0#`) and native/fallback parity.
issues.root_cause: See ARCHIVE_LOG.md CQL-05 SKEPTIC section for detailed root cause.
issues.resolution: `QuantityToString` normalizes JSON numeric values to CQL Quantity string format with at least one fractional digit.
issues.verified_in: Fresh probe; wasm/no-Python surface pytest; conformance 2822/2822
